title: Remote test-run wait for a DL560 FULL reports preset 'focused' and null facts while association is stale
outcome: termal_resume_after_test_runs on a remote run whose origin facts are not yet authenticated reports an explicit unknown state, never a default preset such as 'focused', and resolves to the run's real preset and facts once they arrive.
acceptance: A behaviour test registers a remote-run wait before the origin's authenticated facts are available and shows the response reports the preset as unknown or absent (not 'focused') with the stale-association reason.
The same test shows that once authenticated native origin facts for a 'full' run arrive, the wait reports preset 'full' with the run's identity and start time.
The wait's response fields for the stale-association state are documented.
